## 1. Goal

Run the whole viva demo path once end to end and record a 3-minute backup video of the website demo. This is the gate that unlocks all Nice-to-have work.

## 2. Background

**From PRD §1A M13:**

| # | Feature | Owner | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M13 | Backup demo video | Both | 3-minute recording of the website demo, saved locally and in the cloud |

**From PRD §10A Demo script:**

| # | Time | Who | On screen | Says | If it breaks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 0:00–1:00 | Ahaana | Problem slide | The lab-computer story: 16 cores, 32 GB, jobs keep arriving, someone must choose | — |
| 2 | 1:00–4:00 | Krishna | Algorithm slides | Heap with the fixed aging key; the starvation bound; why aging alone fails for big-memory jobs; reservation; complexity table | Slides are local PDF too |
| 3 | 4:00–5:00 | Krishna | Console program on a golden case | "This is the synopsis deliverable: C, structs, heap, greedy, aging, resource check." | Show saved terminal screenshot |

**From PRD §10A If something breaks:**

The speaker keeps talking ("let me show you the recorded run") while the other switches to the backup video at the matching point within 10 seconds. Never debug in front of the examiners.

**PRD §1A rule:** nothing from "Nice to have" starts until every "Must have" row is done and the full demo path has run once end to end (K-32).

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- One full rehearsal of rows 1–9
- A 3-minute screen recording covering rows 4–6
- Saving it locally, on a USB stick and in the cloud

**Out of scope:**

- Final rehearsals and the demo-ready tag (K-41)

## 4. Files

| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs/slides/demo-notes.md` | create | Timings and timestamps in the video (the video itself is not committed) |

## 5. Specification

Video timestamps must match the fallback column of PRD §10A (backup video at 0:00 for row 4, 1:00 for row 5).

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Rehearse once end to end
2. Record the video
3. Note timestamps
4. Store copies

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `full-path` | Rows 1–9 | Completed once without restarting |
| `video-plays` | Open the saved video offline | Plays; timestamps match notes |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] The full demo path has run once end to end (unlocks Nice-to-have work)
- [ ] Video saved locally and in the cloud (M13)
- [ ] Timestamps recorded in `docs/slides/demo-notes.md`

## 9. How to verify

Play the video from the local copy with the network off; check the timestamps.

## 10. Viva notes

**Idea:** never debug in front of examiners; the backup takes over within 10 seconds.
**Examiner question:** "What if the laptop fails?" — Second laptop on the same tag, and the backup video on USB and in the cloud.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Recording before the website is final (re-record later if the UI changes)

## 12. Claude Code prompt

```
Read CLAUDE.md, then this issue (#35) in full.
Goal: Run the full demo path once and record the 3-minute backup video (local + cloud).
Create the branch k/K-32-demo-video from an up-to-date main.
Write the tests in section 7 first, then implement in small commits (present tense, one idea each).
Run the commands in section 9 until everything is green.
Then explain the result in plain English for the viva, covering everything in section 10.
Fill in the PR from .github/pull_request_template.md, tick every box in section 8, and add a line to docs/AI_USE.md.
Stop and wait for review. Do not merge.
```
